correctness.rationale: The discretized model is valid for three particles after one subdivision per edge: each path between distinct essential vertices has at least two edges and every cycle has at least eight. The standalone script enumerates all cells, checks the integral chain condition, and computes exact rational and mod-two boundary ranks. The resulting Betti vectors and Euler characteristic agree, and the universal coefficient theorem gives the stated count of 2-primary summands. The exponent of the \(H_1\) summand and odd-primary torsion are not claimed.
